reason: The cited evidence (E1, E2) does not address coarsening, segregation, or their effects on corrosion/oxidation. E1 is a computational screening for single-phase alloys, and E2 discusses solidification and precipitation simulations but not the proposed mechanism. The key premises lack specific prior support.
premises: As-cast Mg-containing lightweight HEAs contain a solid solution with fine intermetallic precipitates
Thermal exposure can drive diffusion and coarsening of intermetallic precipitates
Coarsening causes elemental segregation at interphase boundaries
Segregation of certain elements promotes formation of a continuous protective oxide
This oxide improves corrosion resistance and high-temperature oxidation behavior
